newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian Jan-June investments soar 8.9 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Romanian Jan-June investments soar 8.9 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Investment in Romania climbed 8.9 percent in the first semester of 1996 from the year ago period to 7.05 trillion lei at end-June, National Statistics Board report showed.
It said construction works accounted for 41.2 percent of six-month investments, down from 43.1 percent a year ago.
Investments in the manufacturing sector took 26.5 percent of the total over January-June, when retail trade, transport, telecoms, banking and real estate held about 43 percent.
The private sector's stake in six-month investments jumped to 48.3 percent this year from 39.0 percent in 1995.
More than 70 percent of January-June investments were funded from companies' own sources, while 6.5 percent of them were financed through local credits.

Official forecasts expected investments to rise by 8.8 percent in 1996. Last year, investments gained 10.5 percent to take 18 percent of gross domestic product. ($=3,162 lei) -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
